import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import zipfile

root = Path.cwd()
out = root / '.pytest_cache/native-artifact-analysis/run-2'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
vs = Path(r'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat')
command = '""' + str(vs) + '" -no_logo -arch=x64 && set"'
r = subprocess.run('cmd.exe /d /s /c ' + command, capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', check=True)
env = os.environ.copy()
for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
    if '=' in line:
        k, v = line.split('=', 1)
        if k:
            env[k.upper()] = v
env['PATH'] = r'C:\Users\xiedc\.cargo\bin;' + env['PATH']
for k in ['RUSTFLAGS', 'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', 'RUSTC_WRAPPER', 'RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER', 'CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS', 'SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH', 'LINK', '_LINK_', 'CL', '_CL_']:
    env.pop(k, None)
env['RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN'] = '1.94.0'
env['CARGO_INCREMENTAL'] = '0'
env['CARGO_HOME'] = str(out / 'cargo-home')
report = {'scope': 'Dependency-free diagnostic only; no pydantic/runtime qualification', 'commands': [], 'cases': [], 'scriptSha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}

def save():
    (out / 'analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding='utf8')

def call(argv, cwd):
    if argv[0] in ('rustc', 'cargo'):
        argv = [str(Path(r'C:\Users\xiedc\.cargo\bin') / (argv[0] + '.exe')), *argv[1:]]
    r = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=90)
    report['commands'].append(dict(argv=argv, cwd=str(cwd), exitCode=r.returncode, stdout=r.stdout, stderr=r.stderr))
    save()
    r.check_returncode()
    return r

def pe(b):
    pe_at = struct.unpack_from('<I', b, 0x3c)[0]
    opt = pe_at + 24
    size_opt = struct.unpack_from('<H', b, pe_at + 20)[0]
    sections = []
    for i in range(struct.unpack_from('<H', b, pe_at + 6)[0]):
        pos = opt + size_opt + 40 * i
        name = b[pos:pos+8].rstrip(b'\0').decode()
        size, rva, raw_size, raw = struct.unpack_from('<IIII', b, pos+8)
        sections.append((name, rva, max(size,raw_size), raw, raw_size))
    def off(rva):
        return next(raw+rva-start for _,start,size,raw,_ in sections if start<=rva<start+size)
    rva, length = struct.unpack_from('<II', b, opt+112+8*6)
    entries=[]
    if rva:
        pos=off(rva)
        for at in range(pos, pos+length, 28):
            _,ts,major,minor,typ,n,adr,raw=struct.unpack_from('<IIHHIIII',b,at)
            e=dict(type=typ,timestamp=ts,bytes=n)
            if typ==2 and b[raw:raw+4]==b'RSDS':
                e.update(guid=b[raw+4:raw+20].hex(),age=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,raw+20)[0],pdb=b[raw+24:raw+n].rstrip(b'\0').decode(errors='replace'))
            entries.append(e)
    return dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),length=len(b),timestamp=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,pe_at+8)[0],debug=entries)

try:
    call(['rustc','-Vv'],out)
    call(['cargo','-V'],out)
    maturin=str(root/'.pytest_cache/native-qualification/venv/Scripts/maturin.exe')
    call([maturin,'--version'],out)
    for variant in ['baseline','epoch','epoch-brepro']:
        if variant!='baseline':
            env['SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH']='1700000000'
        for trial in ['A','B']:
            dest=out/variant/trial
            src=dest/'source'
            (src/'src').mkdir(parents=True)
            (src/'Cargo.toml').write_text('[package]\nname="determinism-canary"\nversion="0.1.0"\nedition="2024"\n[profile.release]\nlto="fat"\ncodegen-units=1\nstrip=true\n',encoding='utf8')
            (src/'src/main.rs').write_text('fn main() { println!("{}", 42); }\n',encoding='utf8')
            env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR']=str(dest/'target')
            flags=['--remap-path-prefix',str(src)+'=/qualification/source']
            if variant=='epoch-brepro':
                flags+=['-Clink-arg=/Brepro']
            env['CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS']='\x1f'.join(flags)
            call(['cargo','generate-lockfile','--offline'],src)
            call([maturin,'build','--bindings','bin','--release','--locked','--offline','--verbose','--target','x86_64-pc-windows-msvc','--out',str(dest/'wheels')],src)
            w=next((dest/'wheels').glob('*.whl'))
            with zipfile.ZipFile(w) as z:
                bom=json.loads(z.read(next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('cyclonedx.json'))))
                b=z.read(next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.exe')))
                report['cases'].append(dict(variant=variant,trial=trial,epoch=env.get('SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH'),flags=flags,pe=pe(b),wheelSha256=hashlib.sha256(w.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),sbom=bom,zipDates=[list(i.date_time) for i in z.infolist()]))
            save()
            time.sleep(1.1)
    report['status']='COMPLETE'
except BaseException as error:
    report['failure']=repr(error)
    raise
finally:
    save()
print(json.dumps([dict(variant=c['variant'],trial=c['trial'],pe=c['pe'],serial=c['sbom'].get('serialNumber'),time=c['sbom']['metadata'].get('timestamp')) for c in report['cases']],indent=2))
